data:
This is a practical, skill-based professional readiness program designed for final-year liberal arts
undergraduates. This course bridges the gap between academia and the corporate world by
equipping students with the mental models, skills, behaviours, and business awareness needed
to transition confidently into the workplace.
Students learn how organizations function, how companies create value, how to navigate
workplace culture and expectations, and how to build a strong professional identity.
The course is structured to level the playing field for new entrants to the corporate world -
focused on empowerment, awareness, and competitive advantage.
